title: Land of Sacred Serpents
requirements: Boarding Permit key item; Treasures of Aht Urhgan content enabled.
steps: Obtain the Boarding Permit through The Road to Aht Urhgan in Lower Jeuno.
Travel to Mhaura and board the mercenary transport bound for Al Zahbi. It arrives in Aht Urhgan Whitegate.
Enter Salaheem's Sentinels at I-10 and walk toward Naja Salaheem. The scene starts as you enter her office area.
Finish the scene and check your temporary key items for the Supplies Package.
notes: The opening mission has no separate job-level or nation-rank check in the pinned server script. Travel through hostile territory comes next.

title: Immortal Sentries
requirements: Complete ToAU 1: Land of Sacred Serpents.
steps: Choose one of the five Immortal sentries. A practical first route is the boat from Whitegate to Nashmau, then the eastern exit into Caedarva Mire.
Use Sneak and Invisible and head east to Azouph Isle Staging Point at K-9. Speak with Nareema inside and hand over the Supplies Package through her dialogue.
Use the Runic Portal inside the staging point to register it and return to Whitegate.
Report to Naja Salaheem at I-10 to join the mercenaries.
notes: Only one delivery is required. The other accepted sentries are Nahshib at Dvucca Isle (Caedarva Mire I-9, second area), Waudeen at Halvung (Mount Zhayolm K-6), Meyaada at Ilrusi Atoll (Arrapago Reef G-5), and Daswil at Mamool Ja (Bhaflau Thickets H-11, second area).
A Runic Portal must be activated at its destination before normal return travel can use it.
reward: 150 Imperial Standing; PSC Wildcat Badge; Private Second Class title.

title: President Salaheem
steps: Speak with Naja about the Mog Locker.
Leave Whitegate and return; entering and exiting your Mog House also changes areas.
Speak with Naja again and finish the scene introducing Raillefal.
notes: Rytaal at K-10 introduces Assault and Imperial Army I.D. Tag services. His explanation is useful but is not required to advance this mission. Fubruhn at F-11 handles Mog Locker administration.

title: Knight of Gold
requirements: 1,000 gil OR one Imperial Bronze Piece.
steps: Speak with Cacaroon and accept his offer of information. Repeat the conversation if another quest takes priority.
After closing the dialogue, trade either exactly 1,000 gil or one Imperial Bronze Piece to Cacaroon.
Walk into Walahra Temple at K-8 for the next scene.
Go to the upper floor of Shararat Teahouse at K-12. Discuss all three topics when prompted and finish the conversation with Raillefal.

title: Confessions of Royalty
steps: Go to Northern San d'Oria, enter Chateau d'Oraguille, and present Raillefal's Letter to Halver.
If the castle guard will not admit you, speak with Guilerme at Northern San d'Oria I-7 and accept his help. He arranges the mission audience and returns you outside afterward.
Finish the audience; the letter is handed over and the mission advances.
notes: A high nation rank is not an additional mission prerequisite: the Guilerme route exists for characters without normal castle access.

title: Easterly Winds
steps: Approach the Grand Duke Palace audience chamber from the stairs in Ru'Lude Gardens.
Accept the request during the summit and choose the answer welcoming a reward to receive the coins.
Keep one inventory slot free and finish the scene.
notes: The pinned mission script imposes no midnight wait here.
reward: 10 Imperial Bronze Pieces if you accept the reward dialogue; the mission can advance without them.

title: Westerly Winds
steps: Return to the upper floor of Shararat Teahouse for a scene with Raillefal. Keep a free inventory slot.
Receive Raillefal's Note and one Imperial Silver Piece, then report to Naja Salaheem at I-10.
Finish her conversation to receive another Imperial Silver Piece and advance.
reward: Two Imperial Silver Pieces in total; Agent of the Allied Forces title. Raillefal's Note is temporary and handed over.

title: A Mercenary Life
steps: Change areas after reporting to Naja in Westerly Winds, then return to Whitegate.
Enter Salaheem's Sentinels and walk toward Naja for the next scene.
Select both discussion topics and finish the briefing.
notes: The pinned server requires zoning here, with no real-world midnight timer.

title: Undersea Scouting
requirements: One Imperial Silver Piece for the normal ruins entrance.
steps: Leave Whitegate through Al Zahbi and travel into Bhaflau Thickets to Kamih Mapokhalam at F-6.
Trade one Imperial Silver Piece for entry into Alzadaal Undersea Ruins.
Inside, head east toward the Gilded Doors at H-8. Approach the doorway to trigger the scene with Ghatsad.
Finish the scene to obtain the Astral Compass.
notes: Optional: Kamih also sells the Map of Alzadaal Ruins for three Imperial Mythril Pieces. To register Nyzul Isle afterward, take the north teleporter, then the west teleporter; use a Runic Portal in the central chamber to return to Whitegate.

title: Astral Waves
steps: Return from Alzadaal Undersea Ruins to Whitegate.
Speak with Naja Salaheem and finish your report.

title: Imperial Schemes
requirements: The next Vana'diel day must begin after ToAU 10; change areas once.
steps: After Astral Waves, change areas and wait for the next Vana'diel day.
Walk onto the first platform of Salaheem's Sentinels at I-10 to trigger the briefing. Talking to Naja alone gives ordinary mission dialogue.
Finish the briefing to receive the ghost-ship assignment.
notes: A Vana'diel day is about 57 minutes 36 seconds in real time. This wait ends at the next game midnight, not after a full day from your turn-in.

title: Royal Puppeteer
requirements: One vial of Jody's Acid for each character progressing.
steps: Obtain one vial of Jody's Acid from Ameretat in Bhaflau Thickets or Wajaom Woodlands, or obtain the tradable item from another player/Auction House.
Take the ship from Whitegate to Nashmau and speak with Pyopyoroon at H-7.
After his opening scene, trade exactly one vial of Jody's Acid and finish the conversation.
reward: Vial of Spectral Scent key item.

title: Lost Kingdom
requirements: Vial of Spectral Scent key item.
steps: Leave Nashmau through its western exit and reach Jazaraat's Headstone at Caedarva Mire E-10.
Examine the headstone for the opening scene. Every character needing credit must see this before the fight.
Prepare for combat, then examine it again to spawn Jazaraat. Defeat him.
Examine the headstone after the victory to receive the Ephramadian Gold Coin and advance.
notes: Bring a level-75 battle setup and healing; the nearby field remains dangerous during the fight. Level 75 is a preparation recommendation, not a scripted minimum.
After this mission the headstone replaces a missing Ephramadian Gold Coin without another Jazaraat battle.

title: The Dolphin Crest
requirements: Keep the Ephramadian Gold Coin for the next mission.
steps: Return to Whitegate after defeating Jazaraat.
Speak with Naja Salaheem and finish the ghost-ship report.

title: The Black Coffin
requirements: Ephramadian Gold Coin for every entrant; consumed on entry.
steps: Carry an Ephramadian Gold Coin. For a missing coin, revisit the headstone in Caedarva Mire E-10.
Travel from Dvucca Isle Staging Point west to the Arrapago Reef entrance at Caedarva Mire F/G-9. In the reef, go north to the Cutter at H-8 on the southwestern ship map.
If Dvucca is unregistered, leave Nashmau west, enter Alzadaal Undersea Ruins from Caedarva Mire D-11 with an Imperial Silver Piece, take the teleporter and exit to the Dvucca-side area.
Approach the Cutter for its scene, then examine it and choose The Black Coffin.
Defeat five Ashu Talif Crew, then fight the Captain and four reinforcements. Reduce the Captain to 20% HP within 30 minutes.
Allow the automatic exit scenes in Arrapago Reef and Nashmau to finish.
notes: Gessho assists. Control the spare crew while concentrating damage. A failed entry/battle needs another coin.

title: Ghosts of the Past
steps: Return from Nashmau to Whitegate.
Speak with Naja Salaheem and finish the report and clothing discussion.
notes: Your clothes alter the conversation, but this particular mission does not require the palace outfit. The next mission does.

title: Guests of the Empire
requirements: Complete ToAU 16: Ghosts of the Past.
An approved body piece; nonempty Hands, Legs and Feet slots; empty Main and Sub slots at the palace.
steps: Talk to Naja, then equip a palace-approved body piece plus separate equipment in Hands, Legs and Feet.
Speak with Naja while dressed correctly and obtain her approval.
Keep that armor equipped and empty both Main and Sub slots, including any shield.
Examine the Imperial Whitegate at L-8/L-9 and finish the palace audience. Leave an inventory slot for the reward.
notes: Accessible examples include Brigandine (level 45, suitable jobs), Holy Breastplate (WHM 40), Justaucorps (58) and Haubergeon (59). Normal and listed HQ variants are accepted. Head equipment is optional.
Completing this story gate satisfies the mission prerequisite for Salvage. Salvage still has its own level, currency and entry requirements.
reward: One Imperial Mythril Piece; Ovjang's Errand Runner title.

title: Passing Glory
requirements: Complete ToAU 17: Guests of the Empire.
Next Vana'diel day after ToAU 17; change areas.
steps: After the palace audience, change areas and wait until the next Vana'diel day.
Enter the second platform of Salaheem's Sentinels at I-10 and finish the automatically triggered scene.
notes: The pinned Zenith base has this continuation even though Horizon reference pages may describe a server-specific stopping point.

title: Sweets for the Soul
steps: Walk into Shararat Teahouse at K-12.
Finish the scene with the visiting ambassador to receive the next assignment.

title: Teahouse Tumult
requirements: Complete ToAU 19: Sweets for the Soul.
steps: Enter Aydeewa Subterrane from Wajaom Woodlands G-7 and watch the arrival scene.
From that entrance map, take the connection at D-8 or E-9 to the lower area containing the tree roots.
Reach F-8/G-8 and select the unlabeled target beside a tree root. Target cycling helps find its blank name.
Watch the scene to finish the investigation.
notes: Bring Sneak and Invisible for the route. This is the same target revisited in Misplaced Nobility.

title: Finders Keepers
steps: Return to Whitegate and enter the second platform of Salaheem's Sentinels.
Finish the automatic scene; speaking to Naja is not the trigger.

title: Shield of Diplomacy
requirements: Access through the Gates of Halvung if using the overland route.
steps: Reach Mount Zhayolm and travel toward Navukgo Execution Chamber at D-8. The overland Gates of Halvung route requires a Cast Metal Plate holder to open the gate.
Enter Navukgo Execution Chamber for one scene, then examine the Decorative Bronze Gate for another.
Examine the gate again, select Shield of Diplomacy, and defeat Khimaira 13 within 30 minutes.
Keep Karababa alive during the battle; do not let her remain at critically low HP. Finish the victory scene.
notes: The native battlefield allows Trusts and up to six participants; this is a source check, not a live solo-clear test.
The battle script flags Karababa spell behavior as incomplete. Plan your own healing and damage rather than relying on the retail description of her spell support.

title: Social Graces
steps: Return to the second platform of Salaheem's Sentinels.
Watch the automatic scene to finish the mission.

title: Foiled Ambition
requirements: Next Vana'diel day after ToAU 23; change areas.
steps: After Social Graces, change areas and wait for the next Vana'diel day.
Walk into the second platform of Salaheem's Sentinels and finish the scene.
Keep an inventory slot available for the stack of Imperial Gold Pieces.
reward: Five Imperial Gold Pieces; Karababa's Secret Agent title.

title: Playing the Part
requirements: Next Vana'diel day after ToAU 24; change areas.
steps: After Foiled Ambition, change areas and wait for the next Vana'diel day.
Speak with Naja. Choose Aphmau when the conversation asks for the relevant name and finish the briefing.

title: Seal of the Serpent
requirements: Empty Main and Sub equipment slots.
steps: Empty Main and Sub equipment slots, including shields or a second weapon.
Examine the Imperial Whitegate and finish the audience.
notes: The palace-approved body armor check from Guests of the Empire is not applied to this audience. Ranged and Ammo slots can remain equipped.

title: Misplaced Nobility
requirements: Complete ToAU 26: Seal of the Serpent.
steps: Return through Wajaom Woodlands G-7 to Aydeewa Subterrane.
Take the D-8 or E-9 connection to the lower tree-root area used in Teahouse Tumult.
Examine the same blank target at F-8/G-8 and finish the scene with Rishfee.

title: Bastion of Knowledge
steps: Return to Whitegate and walk inside Walahra Temple.
Finish the automatic scene with Aphmau.

title: Puppet in Peril
steps: Use a Runic Portal Use Permit to travel to Mamool Ja Staging Point. Leave its outer gate and go north to the Jade Sepulcher entrance at Bhaflau Thickets H-8, on the staging-point map.
If the staging point is not registered, reach this side of Bhaflau Thickets through Mamook.
In Jade Sepulcher, examine the Ornamental Door for a scene. Examine it again and choose Puppet in Peril.
Defeat Lancelord Gaheel Ja within 30 minutes and finish the victory scene.
notes: Use a normal travel permit, not an active Assault Order, when you need to leave a staging point through its outer gate.
Native battlefield: Trusts allowed, maximum six participants. The source notes missing boss dialogue and potentially incomplete additional mechanics.

title: Prevalence of Pirates
steps: Travel to Dvucca Isle Staging Point and head west to the Arrapago Reef entrance at Caedarva Mire F/G-9.
Watch the scene on entering the reef. If arriving through another entrance, the scene still flags the mission step.
Go north to the Cutter at H-8 on the southwestern ship map and approach it for another scene.
Finish the scene to obtain the Periqia Assault Area Entry Permit.
reward: Periqia Assault Area Entry Permit key item.

title: Shades of Vengeance
requirements: Periqia Assault Area Entry Permit key item; consumed on entry.
steps: Return to Dvucca Isle Staging Point from the Cutter.
Examine the Runic Seal and choose Shades of Vengeance to enter Periqia. Each character on this mission needs the entry permit.
Go to the Lamiae gathered around H-9. Pull carefully and defeat K23H1-LAMIA until the objective completes; the required count varies.
Finish within 30 minutes and allow the exit scene in Caedarva Mire to advance the mission.
notes: If you fail, wait until the next Vana'diel day and talk to Nahshib at Dvucca Isle for a replacement permit. This mission instance is separate from ordinary ranked Assault orders.

title: In the Blood
steps: Return from Periqia to Whitegate.
Speak with Naja and finish the mission report. Keep an inventory slot for the coin.

title: Sentinels' Honor
requirements: Next Vana'diel day after ToAU 32; change areas.
steps: After In the Blood, change areas and wait for the next Vana'diel day.
Speak with Naja and finish the briefing.
Before travelling onward, replace a missing Ephramadian Gold Coin at Jazaraat's Headstone in Caedarva Mire E-10.
notes: No title is awarded by this mission in the pinned native reward table.

title: Testing the Waters
steps: Carry an Ephramadian Gold Coin and return via Dvucca Isle to the Cutter, as in The Black Coffin.
Approach the ship and accept passage when asked.
Continue through the automatic transfer and scene in Talacca Cove. The coin is exchanged for the Percipient Eye.
notes: If you refuse passage, leave Arrapago Reef and re-enter before trying the ship again.
reward: Percipient Eye key item; Treasure Trove Tender title.

title: Legacy of the Lost
steps: From the arrival point, follow the northwest tunnel to the Rock Slab at F-6.
Examine the slab and choose Legacy of the Lost.
Fight Gessho within the 30-minute limit. Concentrate on the original when clones appear; the fight ends at 15% HP.
Finish the victory scene and keep the Percipient Eye for the next mission.
notes: Native battlefield: Trusts allowed, maximum six participants. The key item is not consumed by this fight.
Native code contains clone handling but flags missing dialogue and potentially incomplete additional boss mechanics.

title: Gaze of the Saboteur
requirements: Complete ToAU 35: Legacy of the Lost.
steps: Leave Talacca Cove through its southern exit at G-10 to Caedarva Mire E-9.
Travel west to the Hazhalm Testing Grounds entrance at D-9/D-10.
Enter for the arrival scene, then examine the Entry Gate for the next scene.
Finish the conversation to exchange the Percipient Eye for the Luminian Dagger.
reward: Luminian Dagger key item; Emissary of the Empress title.

title: Path of Blood
requirements: Complete ToAU 36: Gaze of the Saboteur.
steps: Return to Whitegate and enter the second platform of Salaheem's Sentinels.
Finish both linked scenes. The game moves your character within Whitegate between them; allow the second scene to finish.

title: Stirrings of War
requirements: Next Vana'diel day after ToAU 37; change areas.
steps: After Path of Blood, change areas and wait for the next Vana'diel day.
Walk into Shararat Teahouse at K-12 and finish the automatically triggered scene.

title: Allied Rumblings
requirements: Allied Council Summons obtained in the previous mission.
steps: Travel to Jeuno and approach the stairs into the Grand Duke Palace in Ru'Lude Gardens.
Watch the council scene to finish your report.

title: Unraveling Reason
requirements: Next Vana'diel day after ToAU 39; change areas.
steps: Change areas after the council and wait for the next Vana'diel day.
Speak with Pherimociel at G-6 and agree that you are ready to depart.
Allow the linked Wajaom Woodlands scenes to finish. You are moved automatically to the Leypoint and the mission advances after the final scene.
notes: If you asked about the airship too early and saw the not-ready scene, change areas again before returning to Pherimociel. Declining the ready departure can be corrected by talking to him again.

title: Light of Judgment
steps: Return to Whitegate and find Rodin-Comidin on the upper level outside the Automaton Workshop.
Speak with him and accept the assignment to receive the Nyzul Isle Route.
notes: No additional day wait is imposed before Path of Darkness.

title: Path of Darkness
requirements: Nyzul Isle Route key item for the registrant; consumed from entrants carrying it.
steps: Reach Nyzul Isle Staging Point through its registered Runic Portal, or use the Alzadaal teleporter route described in Undersea Scouting.
Every character needing progress should examine the blank lamp at J-9 and agree to enter.
Examine the nearby Runic Seal at I-9 and select Path of Darkness. The registrant needs the Nyzul Isle Route and the lamp scene.
Keep Naja alive. Defeat the four Imperial Gears and reduce Amnaf to 50% HP; follow her retreat, defeat the next four gears and reduce her to 20%.
Defeat the final Psycheflayer form within 30 minutes, then watch the exit scene in Alzadaal.
notes: A dead Naja causes failure. After a loss, Rodin-Comidin at Whitegate I-7 replaces the route key item.
The native Amnaf AI flags parts of her low-HP ability sequence as unfinished. No level-75 solo clear has been verified for Zenith.

title: Fangs of the Lion
steps: Return to Whitegate and walk into the second platform of Salaheem's Sentinels.
Watch the scene to receive the Mythril Mirror.
reward: Mythril Mirror key item; Nashmeira's Loyalist title.

title: Nashmeira's Plea
requirements: Complete ToAU 43: Fangs of the Lion.
Mythril Mirror key item for the registrant; consumed from entrants carrying it.
steps: Bring the Mythril Mirror to Nyzul Isle Staging Point. Examine the blank lamp at J-9 and agree to proceed.
Examine the Runic Seal at I-9 and choose Nashmeira's Plea. The registrant must have the mirror and the lamp scene.
Defeat Raubahn three times; he revives twice. Be able to deal a second damage type for his final life.
Reduce Razfahd to 50% HP. Once both objectives are complete, the scene transitions to Alexander.
Defeat Alexander within the shared 45-minute limit. Keep healing available for Divine Judgment and avoid standing far enough away to trigger draw-in.
Finish the automatic Alzadaal exit scene to advance.
notes: After a loss, Naja at Whitegate I-10 replaces a missing mirror without a day wait.

Native Raubahn approximates his final damage immunity using party main jobs rather than recorded damage. Bring magical damage if your party is mainly melee; retail resistance strategies may not match. His Reraise presentation and Azure Lore logic are incomplete.

title: Ragnarok
steps: Return to Whitegate and enter the second platform of Salaheem's Sentinels.
Finish the automatic scene after the final battle.

title: Imperial Coronation
requirements: Palace-approved body armor; equipment in Hands, Legs and Feet; empty Main and Sub.
steps: Dress as for Guests of the Empire: approved Body plus equipment in Hands, Legs and Feet. Empty Main and Sub.
Leave two free inventory slots and examine the Imperial Whitegate.
Choose Balrahn's Ring, Ulthalam's Ring or Jalzahn's Ring. You may defer the choice instead of deciding immediately.
Finish the coronation and receive the Imperial Standard. An unclaimed initial reward can be requested at the gate while dressed appropriately.
notes: Brigandine, Holy Breastplate, Justaucorps and Haubergeon are examples for eligible jobs.
The native source leaves Nadeey's discarded-ring recovery unimplemented. Keep your chosen ring; this guide does not promise a working ring-exchange service.
reward: Imperial Standard; choice of Balrahn's Ring, Ulthalam's Ring or Jalzahn's Ring.

title: The Empress Crowned
steps: Walk back to the second platform of Salaheem's Sentinels.
Keep an inventory slot free and watch the final crown scene.

title: Eternal Mercenary
steps: Speak with Naja Salaheem for the concluding mercenary conversation.
The story is finished after the crown and finale scenes. Eternal Mercenary remains the terminal entry in the mission log.
notes: Repeated dialogue does not mean another story objective is missing. Abyssea Atma rewards shown by modern references are outside this level-75 guide.
